title: Sortable solution order on the live index card, sent by the coordinator's reorder path
goal: A drag on the card ends as a PR link, never a silent write
acceptance: The card lists the solution order with the bricks sortable list (bricks:F-015-T02); Save sends the new order and the base it loaded by the path coordinator:F-025-T02 chose, and shows the PR link or the stale-list message
No write to git happens in NERV unless coordinator:F-025 chose the NERV-job option; then it opens a PR and never merges
Tests across the join: card to the reorder call, with a fake coordinator, for success, stale base and unknown reference
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One list on an existing card plus one call; the write path is the coordinator's. Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
